_template_instructions: Copy this file to outputs/[work-type]/[work-name]-state.json before running /prd-graph or any loop. Remove this field from your copy. Update after every run.

criteria_failed_evidence._instructions: Key = criterion text. Value = array of reviewer quotes. Remove this field from your copy.
Criterion text here: Reviewer name: 'exact quote from the revised PRD'

known_failure_modes: _instructions: Record here when a criterion passes the gate but shouldn't have. Remove this field from your copy.
Example: Criterion 3 passed but the owner was listed as TBD. Tighten criterion to require a named person.
next_trigger: Describe the condition that must be true before the next run. E.g. 'Re-run after Chris answers Q1 and the two SQL counts are observed.'
